text:
ops-monitor: PagerFlow alert: pages to #oncall are being suppressed by filter loop — looks like the new dedupe/rate filter re-applied repeatedly. No live pages for ~12m, customers reporting delayed fallbacks. Investigating now.

alex: ack. manual page sent to oncall and pinged SRE. @incidentbot can you show the matching rule? :eyes: 

incidentbot: Received webhook for alert 1775551234. Matched suppression rule `auto-squelch-v2` (signature: hdr_hash=0x4f2a). Logged and returned 200. Did NOT fanout to oncall due to `repeat_threshold` loop detected.

samir: running quick query on filter decisions: ```bash
curl -s "https://internal.pagerflow/api/decisions?alert=1775551234" | jq '.decisions[] | {rule_id: .rule_id, reason: .reason, applied_at: .ts}'
```

priya: temp mitigation applied: disabled `auto-squelch-v2` on us-west shard and flipped fallback route to `pager-proxy-v1` so pages will bypass the new filter. Monitoring for 10m.

maria: customer impact notes: two Dedicated tenants reported missed pages (support tickets 9821, 9822). One enterprise customer saw an SLA latency spike and opened a support case. No data loss.

alex: thanks. Samir — can you confirm whether the dedupe logic re-enqueued the same signature repeatedly? Also check if rollout from last night touched the regex.

samir: preliminary: looks like a retry loop in the filter worker where `last_seen` wasn't being updated after a hash collision. Patch attached to my fork, will push hotfix to staging then prod if green.

ops-bot: playbook triggered: `ops/playbooks/pagerflow-suppression.md` — runbook step 3 executed (toggle rule off).

priya: after toggle, pages are flowing. I see oncall acks coming through. Holding mitigation for 30m before re-enabling with tighter guard rails.

alex: creating incident ticket INC-2026-0317 and assigning to eng-runtime + eng-sre for follow-up and postmortem. Please include timeline, root cause (filter worker race), and rollout rollback plan.

maria: will escalate customer cases and prepare comms if anything regresses.

samir: hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/internal/pagerflow/pull/342 — small state update to avoid duplicate reapply. Will watch for 20m then cut stable.

alex: good job. Postmortem owners: samir (tech), priya (mitigation), maria (customer comms). Closing live thread when stable. :thumbsup:
